name: Slack Collaboration & ChatOps Integration
description: Integration pack for Slack, providing connectivity to Slack Web API (chat.postMessage), Incoming Webhooks, Slash Commands, and Block Kit interactive message notifications for ChatOps workflows.

capabilities.name: Integration Engineering
capabilities.description: Integrates Slack bot user OAuth tokens, Webhooks, and Block Kit message formatting.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Management
capabilities.description: Integrates Slack automated release announcements, build status alerts, and incident channel updates.

checklists.name: Slack Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Slack Bot Token permissions, incoming webhooks, and Block Kit payload validation.

items.statement: Slack Bot User OAuth Token grants chat:write and channels:read scopes.
Incoming Webhooks post rich Block Kit formatted messages to target Slack channels.
Slack Slash Commands process user interactions and return instant ephemerally formatted responses.

reviewGates.name: Slack ChatOps Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Collaboration Lead confirms that Slack Bot tokens and incoming webhooks post notifications properly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Slack integration verify message delivery and Block Kit payload formatting?
